reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: MLPs trained on ab initio liquid data are known to capture complex configurational spaces better than EAM, and improved phase-space overlap should reduce TI path mismatch, though the claimed 30–50% reduction is speculative without evidence.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion (less than ~30% mismatch reduction or no marked overlap improvement), but the benchmark free-energy dataset and overlap metrics need more precise specification.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful hypothesis for researchers working on free-energy calculations of high-entropy alloys, as it directly addresses a known limitation of TOR-TILD and proposes a concrete, testable methodological improvement.
